items.title: ‘Nothing justifies this’ – Chelsea fans rage as Xabi Alonso ‘makes popular star warm up twice then refuses to play him’
items.summary: CHELSEA fans raged as Estevao was left on the bench against Liverpool. The Brazilian, 19, did not come on before the Blues were dumped out of the Carabao Cup on penalties following a 1-1 draw at Anfield.
